description: Original one-owner AI-assisted public HTTP402 CORS remediation microservice; machine-readable seller metadata, not proof of any completed payment or outside customer.
service_name: x402 Browser HTTP 402 CORS Remediation Blueprint (Public Headers)
provider_base_chain_usdc: Buyer pays platform-managed x402 USD-priced USDC, subject to actual independent challenge and approval. Never infer price/payTo from this file.

request_body_format.input: Object matching input_schema; redact all keys, cookies, signatures, wallet addresses and customer data.

browser_origin.description: Exact public https:// browser Origin; localhost local development also allowed. No paths, cookies or credentials.

intended_method.description: The buyer's proposed paid endpoint method; no paid requests are sent.

server_framework.description: Framework/proxy you control; recommendations are unexecuted examples, not vendor-specific certification.

public_402_headers.description: Unsigned public HTTP 402 response status and only safe CORS HEADER NAMES/VALUES. Redact quote blobs, bearer values, signature, private addresses and cookies.

public_options_headers.description: Optional public OPTIONS preflight HTTP status and safe CORS allowed-origin/method/header names and values. No auth, cookies or signatures.

observed_browser_symptom.description: Sanitized browser console error text and visible behavior, no nonpublic tokens or user data.

disclaimers: No customers or revenue from this offering independently verified.
Do not send credentials, transaction signatures, wallet phrases, private customer logs or protected files.
This microservice returns analysis based on buyer-supplied sanitized headers; no live payment, chain, security audit or signed retry verification.
Follow the provider real quote and owner-controlled buyer wallet authorization; never auto-pay.
No claim that HTML browser page provides a checkout: machine endpoint is POST-only and buyer requires supported x402 client.
